Done. The T3 export completed on the first execution and the self-report is written.

**What the script does** (`out/T3/solution.py`):
- Loads the 244 input tensors, casts the 64 projection matrices to bfloat16 via an anchored regex on the four exact module names, and upcasts everything else to float32.
- Drops the 48 attention buffers by an anchored regex that leaves the projection biases untouched.
- Runs all required checks before writing: 64 bfloat16 tensors, layer 0 QKV is bfloat16, the input embedding is float32, 196 tensors total, plus shape preservation and no-parameter-deleted checks.
- Greedy-packs shards under 256 MiB, with oversized tensors alone in their own shard, and verifies the written files against the index afterward.

**Output** in `out/T3/`:

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Shards | 9 files, HuggingFace naming `model-0000N-of-00009.safetensors` |
| Tensors | 196 in index and on disk |
| Executions | 1, no failures |

The two embedding matrices become 412 MB each after upcasting to float32, so each occupies its own shard. The task text's "206 MB" figure was their float16 size, which I noted as a minor ambiguity in the report along with the unspecified shard naming scheme.
